# Reporting Guidelines
# =====================

# In Scope:
# - Authentication & Authorization vulnerabilities
# - SQL Injection, XSS, CSRF
# - Remote Code Execution (RCE)
# - Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
# - Islamic content integrity issues
# - Data leakage and privacy violations
# - Cryptographic vulnerabilities

# Out of Scope:
# - Social engineering attacks
# - Physical attacks
# - Denial of Service (DoS/DDoS)
# - Issues in third-party APIs
# - Publicly disclosed vulnerabilities

# Response Timeline:
# - Initial response: Within 24 hours
# - Vulnerability assessment: Within 3-5 business days
# - Fix deployment: Based on severity (Critical: 24-48h, High: 1 week, Medium: 2 weeks)
# - Public disclosure: 90 days after fix deployment

# Reward Program:
# We offer rewards for valid security vulnerabilities:
# - Critical: $500-$2000
# - High: $200-$500
# - Medium: $50-$200
# - Low: Recognition and acknowledgment

# Islamic Content Security:
# Special consideration for vulnerabilities affecting:
# - Quran text integrity
# - Arabic text rendering
# - Islamic content authentication
# - Prayer time accuracy

# Contact Information:
# Primary: security@quranapp.com
# Emergency: +1-XXX-XXX-XXXX (24/7 security hotline)
# PGP Fingerprint: XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX  XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX

# Thank you for helping keep QuranApp secure!
# May Allah reward your efforts in protecting this Islamic service.
